focus_area_title: Show Employees You Care About Them
content_text_body:
Seeking and embracing opportunities to connect on a human level with your team is the first step to show them that you care. This is especially important during stressful times.

First, read this article on [ways to build a culture of caring](https://www.inc.com/adam-fridman/5-ways-to-build-a-culture-of-caring.html) to recognize which recommendations you can start implementing with your team to help them feel cared for during a time of stress.

### Remember to encourage your employees to be their best selves

Dedicate time to learn more about their aspirations and career goals. Meet with them in weekly one-on-ones to give each employee individual attention. Ask what's on their mind. Listen to their fears, goals, and desires. Empower them to continue learning and encourage them to engage in development opportunities such as training, mentoring sessions, and professional conferences.   

### Ask your employees what they need

Talk with employees one-on-one and let them describe what they're going through. Try to "put yourself in their shoesâ€ so you truly understand what they think and feel, even if you don't agree or feel the same thing. Showing empathy will establish the trust you need to move into problem-solving mode. Find out what would be most helpful at this time. Be open to providing some extra support, advice on prioritizing their work, or increased flexibility.

### Encourage self-care

Taking time to care for ourselves during challenging times will help us manage stress. Encourage your team members to take extra care of themselves with good sleep, exercise, and nutrition habits.   While it's not a manager's place to dictate these behaviors, it's OK to give advice, especially based on your own experience and what's worked for you.
